title: Basic treatment (any two electrotherapy modalities)
description: Includes IFT, Ultrasound, TENS, Stimulator, Hydrocollator packs, Traction, Infrared radiation and Taping — any two modalities per session.

title: Manual therapy
description: Hands-on techniques including joint mobilisation, manipulation and soft tissue work to restore movement and reduce pain.

title: Cupping therapy
description: An ancient healing practice with a strong place in modern physiotherapy — used for pain relief, muscle recovery and improving blood flow.

title: Dry needle therapy
description: Also known as Trigger Point Dry Needling — a procedure using thin needles to release myofascial trigger points and relieve muscle pain.
